from primitive_api import (
    check_activity_success,
    get_task_context,
    list_actions,
    list_executable_actions,
    query_symbolic_state,
)

ctx = get_task_context()
print("Context:", ctx)
print("Success check:", check_activity_success())

all_actions = list_actions(limit=200)
print(f"Total actions listed ({len(all_actions)}):", all_actions)

exec_actions = list_executable_actions(limit=100)
print(f"Executable actions ({len(exec_actions)}):", exec_actions)

char_state = query_symbolic_state("character")
print("Character state:", char_state)
